python3 -c "import pandas as pd; df = pd.read_csv('data/housing_dataset.csv'); 
# Convert categorical to dummy variables

python3 -c "import pandas as pd; df = pd.read_csv('data/housing_dataset.csv'); 
# Identify numeric and categorical columns
num_cols = ['price', 'area', 'bedrooms', 'bathrooms', 'stories']
cat_cols = ['mainroad', 'guestroom', 'basement', 'hotwaterheating', 'airconditioning', 'prefarea', 'furnishingstatus']
# Dummy variables for cat cols (handle case sensitivity if any)
df = pd.get_dummies(df, columns=cat_cols)
# Cleanup naming convention to simplify interpretation

# Correlation analysis
